title: Downloads disappear
text: Albums I download for flights disappear from offline mode after the app refreshes.

title: Offline playback fails
text: Downloaded songs still show a network error when I switch to airplane mode.

title: 通勤时无法离线播放
text: 已经下载的歌在地铁没有网络时还是无法播放，一直提示需要联网。

title: Offline queue resets
text: My downloaded queue resets whenever the app is restarted without a connection.

title: 下载内容会消失
text: 每次更新应用后，之前下载的专辑都会从离线列表消失。

title: Cannot verify downloads
text: The app says my playlist is downloaded but half the tracks cannot play offline.

title: Lyrics are late
text: Synced lyrics are several seconds behind the vocals on almost every live track.

title: 歌词不同步
text: 歌词经常比歌曲慢好几句，手动调整后下一首歌又恢复错误。

title: Wrong lyric version
text: The lyrics shown are for the studio recording while the live version is playing.

title: Missing lyrics
text: Popular songs that had lyrics last month now show lyrics unavailable.

title: 歌词滚动卡住
text: 进入副歌以后歌词滚动会卡住，必须重新打开播放页。

title: No manual sync
text: There is no way to report or correct lyrics that are visibly out of sync.

title: Collaborative playlist loses edits
text: Songs added by my friends vanish from our shared playlist a few minutes later.

title: 共享歌单不同步
text: 朋友添加了歌曲，但我的共享歌单一直看不到这些修改。

title: Duplicate collaborative edits
text: Each collaborative edit creates duplicate tracks when two people update together.

title: Cannot identify editor
text: Shared playlists do not show who removed a track, so changes are impossible to coordinate.

title: 协作修改被覆盖
text: 两个人同时编辑歌单时，其中一方的修改会被直接覆盖。

title: Invites stop working
text: Playlist collaboration invites expire immediately even though the link is new.

title: Recommendations repeat
text: The discovery mix recommends the same artists every day and rarely introduces new music.

title: 推荐越来越重复
text: 每日推荐连续一周都是相同的歌手，完全没有发现新音乐的感觉。

title: Dislikes are ignored
text: I dislike tracks but the recommendation feed keeps bringing those songs back.

title: Wrong genres
text: Recommendations ignore the genres I follow and mostly promote unrelated pop releases.

title: 不理解收听偏好
text: 我主要听爵士乐，但推荐页一直推送完全无关的热门流行歌曲。

title: Discovery feels sponsored
text: The recommendation shelf feels like repeated promotion instead of learning from my listening history.
